lines.text: SR 155 is now open. The speed limit is reduced to 45 MPH through a 32-mile section from MP 46 to 78 for the safety of fire crews entering the highway from side roads. Fire and evacuation information available at: https://www.facebook.com/CCTBroadcasts/

facts.text: Snow left Moses Mtn (5,470 ft) and Gold Mountain (4,500 ft) 16 to 34 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Moses Mtn
evidence.detail: left April 6; earlier seasons: May 16 (2023), May 6 (2024), May 10 (2025)

evidence.name: Gold Mountain
evidence.detail: left April 3; earlier seasons: April 30 (2023), April 3 (2024), April 19 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Moses Mtn (5,470 ft) and Gold Mountain (4,500 ft).

evidence.name: Moses Mtn
evidence.detail: 1.4 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 22.5 in (2023), 10.2 in (2024), 19.4 in (2025)

evidence.name: Gold Mountain
evidence.detail: 0.6 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 12.1 in (2023), 2.4 in (2024), 9.2 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between January 29 and April 9, carried from the melt-out dates at Moses Mtn (5,470 ft) and Gold Mountain (4,500 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Moses Mtn
evidence.detail: melted out April 6, 2,219 ft above the pass; points to January 19 to April 5

evidence.name: Gold Mountain
evidence.detail: melted out April 3, 1,249 ft above the pass; points to February 9 to April 12
